dataset_details.spatial_separation: Strictly >500m from all training points (Zero Spatial Leakage)

scientific_conclusion: On the independent Upper Beas July 2023 event evaluation set (22 spatially disjoint points), Model A (Frozen M7) achieved ROC-AUC: 0.1983, Event Capture: 100.0%. Model B (Experimental PWP-extended) achieved ROC-AUC: 0.4380, Event Capture: 100.0%. Because sample size is constrained (N=22), delta differences are within sampling error margins. Production Model M7 remains FROZEN and unchanged. Model B is cataloged as a verified physical prototype.
